quest.title: The World Is Your Canvas!
quest.description: The warm sunlight shines on your back, urging you to set off once again. Well, what are you waiting for? Stretch your legs and enjoy the Easybreeze Holiday Resort with all your friends!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Easybreeze Badge x1

talks.objective: Return to the resort accommodation and rest

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, let's get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That bed was so comfy. Paimon feels refreshed and ready to go... Which is good, because it's time to get serious about this whole vacation thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're gonna have such a blast today! C'mon, let's go find the others!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Morning, everyone! Sleep well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, all recharged and ready for an adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Same here! Though I might have overdid it last night... Barely slept at all, haha. Despite that, I feel great!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The bed was a little too soft for my liking... Still, I managed to get up early and go on a morning flight — did the usual north to south loop.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The visibility was great. Looked like perfect weather for exploring the resort.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry... I'm late, aren't I? Ugh, I'm so not a morning person. Anyway, have we decided where we're gonna start?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: For me, it's gotta be Wavey Bay! There's so much to do out there on the water. We could spend the whole day there, just choosing activities at random!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'm leaning more towards Guiztli Ridge. When I flew past there earlier, I caught wind that the town there offers head-to-head challenges.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Anywhere's fine with me! I'm happy to go along with whatever you guys decide.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But if you're asking for my personal preference, I'd love to check out the Foamflower Fields over at Colorfall Cliffs.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I've never been on a hot air balloon that hasn't sprung a leak... It must be amazing, seeing the view of the whole resort from up there... as long as I don't fall out, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Relax, captain. We won't let you fall.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks! But, um, I don't really see myself as a captain or anything. Archon knows I'm not cut out for it... You can just call me Bennett.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #As for our itinerary... Why don't we just let {NICKNAME} decide?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me! We're gonna hit all the attractions at some point, anyway, so it's just a matter of where to start.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'm fine with that too. Letting a trusted friend call the shots sounds like a plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No time to lose. Let's go!

talks.objective: Complete the specified objectives in the Easybreeze Album
Complete the specified objectives in the Easybreeze Album
Complete the specified objectives in the Easybreeze Album
Complete the specified objectives in the Easybreeze Album
Return to the resort accommodation and rest

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Good news, good news! {NICKNAME}—

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Can you hear me? Paimon, is {M#he}{F#she} asleep or awake right now?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Must be worn out from all that fun yesterday, huh? Happens to me sometimes, too.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: You feel fine when it's all go go go, but then you finally get a chance to rest, and it's like... Good luck ever getting up again, haha.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: The meeting spot's been changed — yeah, I already heard you loud and clear from next door... What happened to not being a morning person?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Well, that was when we just got here. Now, I'm in full on vacation mode... obviously.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh huh, and why are we waking up earlier and earlier the longer this vacation goes on? That can't be right...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Uh, to maximize our opportunities for fun! C'mon, Paimon, this is basic stuff.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Ah, looks like everyone's here, now. Ahem, okay, I've got some great news to share...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I just checked with the staff, and... Tete Isle is finally open to visitors! Can I get a whoop whoop?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoop whoop! Tete Isle, here we come!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: #How are you feeling now, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Woohoo! A brand-new day, a brand-new adventure!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Let's go!

choices.text: Let's get this show on the road!

dialogues.speaker: Uhane
dialogues.text: Renowned heroes, daring adventurers from afar, beloved guests, welcome... to Tete Isle!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, bottle-popping right off the bat? Huh, they're sure going all-in on the atmosphere building...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You got that right! Tete Isle's all about high-energy party vibes!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "From our honey-sweet Aphimead to our exhilarating shows, there's something for all the senses." That's what the brochure says!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, and we're sure this place is rated E for everyone...?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it! I'm sure there are still plenty of things for little Paimon to enjoy.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: And if not, I'll personally fund something like that for our next visit! How about... "Mualani's Wibbly-Wobbly Wonderland"? Complete with animal slides, musical rocking chairs, and all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... a kids' play area!?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}, this way! The Dance-Off Stage is calling your name!

choices.text: When is it open for business?

dialogues.speaker: Rhythmos
dialogues.text: Hey, you made it! Welcome! This is—

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ooh, leave this bit to me.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ta-da! This is the Dance-Off Stage!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... The name rings a bell, but it sure looks different from the one we know.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It's a Xilonen original. As for the design... I'm guessing probably a client request?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Xilonen recommended you as the DJ! She said you'd be the perfect person to set the place on fire with some high-energy beats.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: You sure she didn't say something more normal like... "fire up the crowd"?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hey, the wilder, the better, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How come she didn't come along herself?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Cause she...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Ahem... I think she's pretty swamped with commissions right now.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah. Anyway, go ahead and give it a spin! She adjusted the modules and stuff to match your height, so it should be a perfect fit.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hey guys, the Asha just noticed that the area around the stage hasn't been painted or decorated yet. Should we add some color first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooooh, that sounds like a great idea!

talks.objective: Give the Dance-Off Stage some color

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: This is so awesome! The stage itself even looks like it's dancing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can already imagine how amazing the show's gonna be!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hey DJ, how about a quick spin? Call it a warm-up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, why not!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Woohoo, shake it!

talks.objective: Operate the Dance-Off Stage and complete the rehearsal

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You called that a warm-up, but... are there really gonna be boats cruising around during the opening ceremony?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Nope! That's when our synergy with {NICKNAME} gets put to the test for real.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: You really can't keep a secret, can you?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hehe... Anyway, time to decide where to head next...

dialogues.speaker: Khonvo
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* What are we gonna do?

dialogues.speaker: Rhythmos
dialogues.text: Hey, something up over there?

dialogues.speaker: Khonvo
dialogues.text: ...Hey, it's that guest in green again. Y'know, the one who showed up first thing this morning.

dialogues.speaker: Rhythmos
dialogues.text: He hasn't left yet?

dialogues.speaker: Khonvo
dialogues.text: I mean, the issue isn't how long he stays... it's whether we run out of Aphimead before he leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh... Paimon has a funny feeling about this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, sorry to interrupt...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, that guest you mentioned... Yeah, there's a high probability he might actually be a friend of ours.

response.speaker: Khonvo
response.text: Oh... Does a guy with two braids and a little white flower tucked under his hat match who you're thinkin'?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Gah, it really is Tone-Deaf Bard!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: You mean Bennett's travel buddy? That bard friend of yours?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But just to be clear, Professor Venti is super responsible! I swear, if this is the first impression he's given you, there must have been some kind of mix-up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bennett really hasn't seen the real Venti yet, huh...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Huh...?

response.speaker: Khonvo
response.text: Uh... Anyway, your friend's at a bar called The Dewdrop, if you wanted to meet up with him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go...

talks.objective: Check out the situation at The Dewdrop

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: On the breeze drifts a fragrance I've sorely missed; Sunsettia's kiss, so tender, so sweet. But ah — what's this? A fiery twist! A Flaming Flower's fury, a flare of searing heat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard! Look at you, sitting here by yourself, sipping away at your drink without a care in the world... You're running this place dry, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, you wound me, fair Paimon! To think, you take me for such an ill-mannered person...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no you don't! Paimon can see you gearing up to make excuses...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm, just give me a... Got it! Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Maybe participation in the brewing process was always meant to be a part of the Tete Isle experience? Why else would their stock of mead be so meager? It must be their intention for visitors to help replenish it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You crafty little...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Fine. That actually does make sense...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #It's been a while, {NICKNAME}! These must be some of your new friends — greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, allow me to introduce you!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: This is Mualani. She's unbeatable out on the water — practically owns Wavey Bay!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And this is Chasca. She's super dependable, and so fast that even her bullets can barely keep up with her!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And then there's this Asha, my new adventure buddy. We're really close already!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hey there, everyone! You can just call me Venti. I like to keep things casual.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's so nice to meet you! Bennett's told us all about you.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, small world — I've heard quite a bit about you from a friend as well.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, who? Kachina? Kinich?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Someone who knows how to party hard... and drink even harder!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, just tell us already!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Could he be talking about Mavuika?)

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It's a secret, and I expect anyone who's guessed the answer to keep it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Man, you're nothing like I thought you'd be.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: When I heard Bennett call you "Professor"... In all honesty, I figured you'd be a lot older!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, well, when I do turn old and gray, I hope I get the chance to hold another love poem crash course...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahem! "You and the Mare Jivari/So close and yet so far/One at the edge of the world/The other in the center of my heart."

choices.text: Hey, wasn't that the poem Bennett wrote?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Well remembered, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: No matter how old I get, I don't think I'll ever forget the poems my students wrote that year. Such a charming little verse... Mm, a charming little verse indeed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Now's probably not the time for a trip down memory lane, is it?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Right you are! Now's the time to raise a glass in celebration of new friendships.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Bartender, a few more glasses of that refreshing Aphimead I was just enjoying, if you'd be so kind!

response.speaker: Anyavu
response.text: I'm afraid you just polished off the very last glass.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh, heh... That's an unlucky coincidence.

response.speaker: Anyavu
response.text: Our exceptionally.... um, well-hydrated guest is certainly right about one thing, however — you're all more than welcome to take part in the "Honeydew Craftbrew" experience and try brewing some yourselves!

response.speaker: Anyavu
response.text: ...Any takers?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Me and hydration station over here will both give it a try.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Sounds great! Where's it taking place?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That didn't take too much convincing...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Well, since {NICKNAME} was kind enough to answer on my behalf, how could I possibly turn down such a warm invitation?

response.speaker: Anyavu
response.text: It's just over there, if you're interested.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: In that case, why don't we all split up for a bit? We can pick a spot to regroup, and meet up there later.

response.speaker: Anyavu
response.text: Oh, I know a place — a little bar called Me & Dew. It's a great place to relax, and there's more than enough mead to go around.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Alright, let's meet there later, then!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oho, Me & Dew, just Me & Dew... Such an aptly poetic name for what I'm sure is a veritable temple of inspiration!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-uh, don't try to bat your eyelashes at Paimon! You're not allowed in another bar until you've at least attempted to replenish what you drank.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ah, well, I suppose you're right...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Anyway, judging from the look on your face, I'm guessing you have quite a few questions for me.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Why are you here? What brings you to Natlan? And why are you suddenly bringing up your poetry class?"

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But questions, dear friends, are like bottles of fine wine — cracking them open is all about waiting for the right moment.

choices.text: Your poetic prowess never ceases to amaze, Prof!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ah, that one was Bennett's handiwork, not mine.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to experience Honeydew Craftbrew

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be the guest in green I've been hearing about... the one who cleaned out our entire stock of mead!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, word sure spreads fast, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: My sincerest apologies. It wasn't intentional, I assure you. The mead was just so irresistible, I felt like lowering my glass would have been an insult to your craft!

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: My... How very kind of you. Guests of your... tolerance level are hard to come by. I meant no offense, either. Please, enjoy as much of our mead as you want...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, in that case, once I'm done here, I'll be sure to head back for a refill!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was being polite, Venti. Not giving you a return ticket to booze town!

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: Haha, hah— ahem... Anyway, before the Honeydew Craftbrew experience officially begins, allow me to give you some background.

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: Aphids play the central role in the brewing of Tete Isle's Aphimead.

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: First, we guide the aphids to gather ripened honeydew from the brewing barrels, which we then collect inside a special device. After that, we refine it using the strength of our tatankasaur companions.

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: With a splash of added flavor or alcohol, the base can be transformed into a range of unique kinds of Aphimead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it's the aphids who do most of the work? Now that's something you don't see in Mondstadt.

talks.objective: Have a brewing competition with Venti
Complete the brewing competition with Venti
Hit the lever to complete the brewing process

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All done!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Who'd have thought it'd be such a breeze? Those little aphids really pull their weight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, we should invite Diluc over to check it out. You'll be lapping up Aphimead over at the Angel's Share in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, nope. Scratch that. The last thing you need is more access to this stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Forget about Master Diluc — let's just sneak a couple of aphids into our pockets and bring them back ourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And if we can't fit them in a pocket, we can always try stuffing them under a hat!

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: Haha, your friend's quite the joker.

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: He is... joking... right?

talks.objective: Head to Me & Dew and meet up with everyone

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hey friends, we're here!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Professor Venti, we were just talking about you!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: We made a bet.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh, on what? How much I can drink? Who guessed the most?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Nope, we can't bet on that because, well... We've all seen it for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We were betting on whether you'd agree to recite one of your poems for us!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And? What was the verdict?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We all bet that you wouldn't.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Aha, trying a bit of reverse psychology, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a move I like to call the "Wind Catcher"!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Told you, this bard's a lot sharper than he lets on.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, I appreciate the compliment!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: But you see, the key ingredient in the honey of inspiration is sweet, sweet nectar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon knows exactly what that means... He's still not done drinking...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Well you're in luck, 'cause Bennett already looked into that for you.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! The boss said we just need to tell her when, and we'll be able to get some more!

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Oh, your friend's here now? Bear with me for one second while I get the equipment up and running...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Whopperflower!? Where did that come from?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Stand back, everyone, and clear the furniture. I'll handle this!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Phew, nothing got wrecked. How's Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is Bennett... laughing?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Back in Mondstadt, whenever I gather flowers, at least half of them turn out to be Whopperflowers, guaranteed...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So, thanks to my bad luck, dealing with them is a piece of cake at this point. This one put up a fight, but I got it in the end!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Out of sight out of mind. C'mon, it's finally time for a toast!

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: I appreciate your help, brave adventurers... Though I do have one more favor to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well, looks like the party's getting postponed again.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: I checked the equipment, and it looks like the Whopperflower was hiding among our Brewblossoms. In other words... there might be a few more lying low in our store room.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: All I need is for you to head down to the cellar and clear out those pesky imposters. If you can manage it, all your drinks tonight are on the house!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Eh-he, in that case, you can count me in too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A... dainty bard like you? Sure you can manage it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, never doubt the morale boosting power of a song! Just make sure to give me a moment to find a safe little corner to hide in.

talks.objective: Go to the lower level of the bar

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Thanks, everyone! Give me a moment, I'll take care of the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That should just about do it, right? If I'd known it'd take this long, I would've ordered something to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I've got a Grainfruit on me. Want some?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Thanks, but no thanks. How'd you even think to bring one of those?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I didn't. A qucusaur gave it to me on the way here, said it was nice and juicy.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So, qucusaurs just give you fruit wherever you go? You Flower-Feather Clan folks live quite the life...

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Everyone, please make your way to the observation deck!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (Camera shows nectar being gathered, followed by a timeline of a spraying bottle.)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Wow, now that's what I call a breathtaking sight! Tete Isle was totally worth saving till last!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: A moment all the more precious because of the toil that shaped it...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well said, bard. For that, you deserve a toast...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, where's our drinks?

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Coming right up!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, I don't know about the rest of you... But, I would much prefer to be outdoors right now.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Why don't we take our food and drinks on the go and have ourselves a picnic on the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Great idea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on... Shouldn't we take a photo first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, Mualani. You've done how many countdowns so far? Why is Paimon the one remembering this stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hehe, 'cause I care more about the party than the prize.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You get in the photo too, Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, sure.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Look at the camera, everyone! Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's party!

talks.objective: Go to the picnic spot on the mountaintop

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Nothing else is gonna pop out at us, right? We're in the clear? Just gonna do a quick countdown to be safe... Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ahem, alrighty then, everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Everyone
dialogues.text: Cheers!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Mmm, now that hit the spot!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It's getting dark, so we'd better call it a day. Get some rest tonight, guys — we can claim our prizes tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what about the food! Let's dig in while it's still hot! Mmm... Meat beats Grainfruit any day of the week!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'm with you on that!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You begin to swap stories from your journey, gazing out at the sunset and stunning scenery before you...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: By the time you've all had your fill, the night sky is ablaze with stars...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'll buy some jerky for Razor, a box of Saurus Crackers for Klee, and some sweet bread for Fischl...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: As for my dads... Something healthy, yet tasty at the same time. Hmm... I know, I'll get them each a Cup O' Grainfruit.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The way things have been looking lately, I'm sure I'll manage to get my hands on some fantastic local specialties and snacks. My bag's gonna be fit to burst!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: See? I recommend wearing lake blue, and now all his troubles are gone! I knew I had a knack for lucky colors.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Maybe I should make some lake blue floaters? Or even open a little shop at Easybreeze Market?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hmm, gotta give it some thought...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Y'know, it's one thing to brave the path of adventure, but to get back out there time and time again even after you fail... Our team captain sure is something.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: A true adventurer if I ever saw one.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: After all, a bird that's flown through some storms all its life is bound to turn out to be a better flier than those who stay sheltered in their nests.

dialogues.speaker: Khonvo
dialogues.text: Dude, play me something intense... I need to unwind.

dialogues.speaker: Rhythmos
dialogues.text: Yo, man! I've got you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Time to rest?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I don't think I can reach...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Does this star need to be colored too?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Speaking of color, we're a little short over here...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Awesome! Thanks a bunch!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Whoa, this fits perfectly!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Nice work.

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: Please gently guide the Aphids...

dialogues.speaker: Takhar
dialogues.text: Good luck, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe whacking this lever might do something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, that's the three main challenges done and dusted! That just leaves Tete Isle, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's head back and get some rest. With any luck, it'll be open to visitors by tomorrow morning.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: This must be where they put on their shows. It's huge!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The resort's grand opening ceremony will be held right here! We do NOT wanna miss that!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: How's Bennett been doing the past few days?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's been having a great time with the rest of us! Speaking of which... His sudden lucky streak wouldn't have anything to do with you, would it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, who's to say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, you and your non-answers! At this rate, Paimon should've named you "Acts-coy-to-avoid-giving-any-actual-answers Bard" instead!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The staff member quickly adjusted the Aphimead refining equipment...
